oil.when: 2015–2016 using the Driver Information Center controls on the right of the steering wheel
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
With the ignition on, use the DIC controls on the right side of the steering wheel to bring up OIL LIFE in the instrument cluster.
Press and hold SEL for a few seconds until the CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON message clears and oil life shows 100%.
oil.note: Checked in the 2015 and 2016 owner's manuals.

oil.when: 2015–2016 accelerator pedal method (no steering-wheel buttons needed)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition on with the engine off.
Push the accelerator pedal all the way down and let it up three times within five seconds.
Check the oil life reading on the Driver Information Center. If CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON is still showing or returns at the next start, repeat the steps.
oil.note: Checked in the 2015 and 2016 owner's manuals.

oil.when: 2008–2014 using the Driver Information Center buttons (Vehicle Information and SET/RESET)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition on without starting the engine.
Press the Vehicle Information button on the DIC until OIL LIFE REMAINING shows.
Press and hold the SET/RESET button for more than five seconds, until the reading changes to 100%.
Turn the ignition off. If CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON comes back at the next start, the reset did not take; repeat the steps.
oil.note: Checked in the Escalade/ESV convenience guide printed in 2007 and the 2010, 2012 and 2014 owner's manuals.

tpms.when: 2015–2016 after the low tire pressure light came on
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the Tire and Loading Information label in the driver's door opening.
There is no reset button: the low tire pressure light stays on until the pressures are corrected, then goes out.
Check that the light has gone out. If it stays on, recheck all four tires with a gauge and have the system checked if they are correct.
tpms.note: Checked in the 2015 and 2016 owner's manuals. If the light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault that inflating the tires will not clear.

tpms.when: 2008–2013 after the low tire pressure light came on
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the Tire and Loading Information label in the driver's door opening. Cold means parked for at least three hours or driven no more than about a mile.
There is no reset button: the low tire pressure light stays on until the pressures are corrected, then goes out.
Check that the light has gone out. If it stays on, recheck all four tires with a gauge and have the system checked if they are correct.
tpms.note: Checked in the Escalade/ESV convenience guide printed in 2007 and the 2013 owner's manual. If the light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault that inflating the tires will not clear.

notes: The oil life system does not reset itself after an oil change, so reset it every time, and only after the oil has actually been changed.
